common_prompt: 请完成下方合成决策简报任务。只使用题目给出的材料，不调用工具，不读取或写入文件，不补充外部资料，不问澄清问题。区分事实、个人偏好、建议、批准与未知项；严格遵守题目要求的范围和格式。

review_policy.hard_criteria_judgment: Accept any semantically equivalent answer supported by the frozen case prompt; do not require exact wording and do not add post-hoc requirements.

decision_gate.core_failure_definition: A repetition has a core failure when any zero-based criterion index listed in that case's core_criteria is false in the completed blind review.
